decision.explanation: Two distinct individuals are presented as spouses of Concepción Villafuerte Blanco in separate documents. Document d1 explicitly states that she married Princess Wilhelmine, Duchess of Sagan in 2001 (D1S9). Document d2 describes a long-term relationship and eventual marriage to Amado Avendaño Figueroa, with evidence including a 1972 article and his memoir (D2S14–D2S19). These are two separate claims involving different persons and timelines. Since both are independently supported and do not share the same referent, both are retained as valid answers.
